title: Mihanada Pectolite
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kurihara is always second in his year behind class representative Kawase and feels crushed by his parents' pressure; his small appetite and weak health send him to the school clinic at exam time. After Kawase learns of their one-sided rivalry, he cannot stop thinking about Kurihara, and the rivals become lovers (publisher blurb, MangaUpdates). One volume.
life_message: Worth is not measured by rank; being cared for can free someone from self-hatred.
